local_hardware_assumption: Task 1 evidence: local-only host with 2x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, 24564 MiB each. Task 2 did not start, download, benchmark, or use cloud inference.
native_success_definition: A local model/engine route that ingests explicit audio tokens plus visual input and passes controlled audio-positive, no-audio, beep-only, Korean phrase, AV sync, and cross-modal event probes. AAC embedded inside MP4 video_url alone is not counted.

source_findings.status: searched after direct fetch transport failure
source_findings.finding: Google model card/search excerpts list E2B and E4B as Text/Image/Audio; 31B as Text/Image with no audio encoder; audio max length 30s; video handled as frames.

source_findings.status: direct fetch transport failure; corroborated by model card and vLLM docs
source_findings.finding: Gemma audio use is documented for E2B/E4B and should be exercised through explicit audio content, not hidden MP4 audio.
vLLM recipe lists google/gemma-4-E2B-it and google/gemma-4-E4B-it as 1x 24GB+ BF16 models, says Gemma 4 E2B/E4B include audio, requires vllm[audio], and shows audio_url plus image/video examples.

vLLM Gemma4 multimodal source validates audio only when hf config has audio_config, includes image/audio/video modalities, and notes video is decomposed into timestamped image frames rather than a separate native video tower.

Qwen2.5-Omni processes text, images, audio, and video; Transformers usage requires qwen-omni-utils and consistent use_audio_in_video; BF16 7B video memory is above a single 24GB GPU for 15s video, while 4-bit quantized 7B and 3B routes reduce fit risk.

SGLang is not the preferred Gemma4 route on the current 2x4090 host because prior 31B experiments hit memory/performance and Gemma4 vision AWQ support limitations; vLLM remains the local serving default.
Current google/gemma-4-31B-it vLLM video_url AAC MP4 path is recorded as not accepted for native audio success.

candidates.name: gemma4-e4b
candidates.engine: vLLM OpenAI-compatible local server with vllm[audio] support
candidates.local_gpu_fit_assumption: Primary candidate. vLLM recipe lists E4B IT as 1x NVIDIA 24GB+ BF16; the project host has 2x4090 24GB. Actual local startup, mm limits, and probe behavior remain Task 4 evidence, not Task 2 claims.
candidates.api_shape: OpenAI chat/completions multimodal content parts. Use image_url[] for recent frames or video_url for frame-extracted visual context, plus explicit audio_url WAV or input_audio base64 WAV. Launch with limit-mm-per-prompt including audio; do not rely on embedded MP4 AAC.
candidates.go_condition: Attempt first. Go if local vLLM starts google/gemma-4-E4B-it without OOM, /v1/models returns it, config exposes audio_config, explicit WAV audio with visual input is accepted, and controlled native audio/cross-modal probes pass.
candidates.no_go_condition: No-go if access/download is unavailable, vLLM image lacks Gemma4 audio support or vllm[audio] deps, audio_config is absent, input_audio/audio_url is rejected, startup exceeds local GPU constraints, or ablation probes fail.
candidates.access_license_availability_risks: Gemma 4 model card lists Apache 2.0; Hugging Face/Kaggle access may still require authenticated download/cache acceptance. Use only local cached/downloaded weights and no hosted inference.
candidates.serving_shape_uncertainty: vLLM docs show audio_url; repo native path may prefer input_audio base64 WAV. Accept either explicit WAV shape only if the local vLLM build proves it. Video is visual frames in vLLM source, not proof that MP4 audio is consumed.

candidates.name: gemma4-e2b
candidates.engine: vLLM OpenAI-compatible local server with vllm[audio] support
candidates.local_gpu_fit_assumption: Second candidate. vLLM recipe lists E2B IT as 1x NVIDIA 24GB+ BF16 and Google/HF model card excerpts list the same audio-capable modality set as E4B. It should be the safer same-family fit if E4B fails.
candidates.api_shape: Same explicit local multimodal shape as E4B: image_url[] or video_url for visual context plus explicit audio_url WAV or input_audio base64 WAV. Do not infer audio success from MP4 video_url alone.
candidates.go_condition: Attempt second only after E4B no-go evidence. Go if local vLLM exposes audio_config for E2B, accepts explicit WAV audio plus visual input, and passes the same native audio and cross-modal probes.
candidates.no_go_condition: No-go if checkpoint access is unavailable, vLLM lacks E2B audio_config support, explicit WAV payloads fail, local startup fails, or model quality cannot satisfy Korean phrase, beep/no-audio ablation, AV sync, and cross-modal tests.
candidates.access_license_availability_risks: Gemma 4 model card lists Apache 2.0; authenticated Hugging Face/Kaggle access/cache may be needed. Smaller size reduces VRAM risk but does not remove model quality risk.
candidates.serving_shape_uncertainty: Expected to match E4B in vLLM, but Task 4 must verify exact accepted OpenAI-compatible audio part type and launch flags on the local image.

candidates.name: qwen2.5-omni
candidates.engine: Transformers + qwen-omni-utils local inference first; vLLM only if local explicit AV parity is proven
candidates.local_gpu_fit_assumption: Third candidate. README BF16 memory guidance makes 7B video risky on 24GB GPUs, especially beyond short clips; 7B GPTQ/AWQ quantized or 3B local routes are the plausible local-fit paths. No Task 2 benchmark or cloud inference was run.
candidates.api_shape: Qwen typed conversation content with audio/video/image/text parts, processed by Qwen2_5OmniProcessor and qwen_omni_utils.process_mm_info. For video audio, keep use_audio_in_video consistent in preprocessing, processor call, and generate; for mixed media, preserve explicit audio/video fields.
candidates.go_condition: Attempt third only after Gemma4 E4B and E2B no-go evidence. Go if a local quantized 7B or 3B route loads without hosted services and passes the same native audio, visual, AV sync, Korean phrase, and cross-modal event probes.
candidates.no_go_condition: No-go if only cloud/API inference works, local quantized/3B checkpoints cannot fit, required dependencies or model code are unavailable, use_audio_in_video cannot be deterministic, vLLM serving lacks required AV parity, or latency/complexity prevents controlled local probes.
candidates.access_license_availability_risks: README points to public Hugging Face/ModelScope checkpoints and quantized 4-bit releases; verify the exact checkpoint license/terms before product use. Third-party deps include transformers, accelerate, ffmpeg, and qwen-omni-utils/decord.
candidates.serving_shape_uncertainty: Transformers path is the documented native path; vLLM support exists in Qwen docs but must be rechecked locally for audio output/input parity. Prefer return_audio=false for text-only probe outputs unless speech synthesis is explicitly needed.

candidates.name: local-asr-contingency
candidates.engine: Local ASR sidecar plus existing Gemma4 31B image/frame path
candidates.local_gpu_fit_assumption: Degraded composed route. It can be CPU or local-GPU ASR, but only after all native candidates have no-go evidence. It does not prove audio-token ingestion by the multimodal model.
candidates.api_shape: Local WAV audio is transcribed to text, transcript text is injected into the prompt, and existing image_url[] frame context is sent to the vision model. No native audio tokens are sent to the LLM.
candidates.go_condition: Allowed only as fallback after Gemma4 E4B, Gemma4 E2B, and Qwen2.5-Omni have documented no-go evidence, and only if UI/docs label it degraded non-native behavior.
candidates.no_go_condition: No-go as primary route, no-go if it requires hosted ASR or cloud inference, and no-go if anyone presents transcript fusion as native audio understanding.
candidates.access_license_availability_risks: Must use local ASR only; exact ASR model/license remains a later contingency decision. It is intentionally excluded from native success.
candidates.serving_shape_uncertainty: None for native audio because this is not native. Its only acceptable shape is an explicitly labeled fallback transcript-fusion path.
